rationale: Both reviews are thorough and well-evidenced with file:line grounding, but the ground truth's dominant, thrice-repeated concern is that the platform.py default flip is validated only on Qwen-Image yet applies globally, with the reviewer explicitly suggesting scoping via _DIFFUSION_IR_OP_PRIORITY_FUNCS — Y hits this almost verbatim (naming the exact registry mechanism and Cosmos3 precedent as the fix), while X raises the same concern but less precisely tied to the suggested resolution. X compensates with a stronger direct hit on the ground truth's ask to report accuracy metrics (SSIM/PSNR) alongside latency, which Y instead self-resolves via its own verification rather than flagging as outstanding. Neither candidate catches Gaohan123's 'pytest mark is not complete' comment. Y's additional findings (missing Part 2 regression test, ROCm/XPU asymmetry, docstring signal loss with a concrete rewrite) are actionable and well-grounded, giving it a slight edge in overall recall and actionability.
